description: This Java class 'StoreLandingDescription' represents a data entity for storing landing page descriptions related to a store, including fields such as title, description, keywords, homepage content, and language. It implements Serializable for object serialization and provides getter and setter methods for all its attributes.

classes.name: StoreLandingDescription
classes.description: A serializable Java class encapsulating store landing page descriptive fields such as title, description, keywords, homepage content, and associated language.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords associated with the store landing page.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the store landing page.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the store landing page.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Associates a Language object with this store landing description.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object associated with this description.
